# Johnny Joe — Senior Export Engineer, Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd.

> Personal profile page of Johnny Joe, Senior Export Engineer at Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd., a Chinese manufacturer of pre-engineered steel buildings. The page explains how a building is engineered and shipped to a buyer several thousand kilometres away: structural parameters, roof and wall cladding, corrosion protection, wind loading, detailing and export packing, plus the export markets (Africa and South America) and the twelve questions buyers ask most often.

## Key pages

- [Profile](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/): who Johnny Joe is, what the company does, how a project is engineered, detailed and shipped.
- [Engineering notes](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/): first-person technical notes written by the engineer handling the enquiry, not marketing copy.
- [Company website](https://www.hongjishunda.com/): company information, product range and news.
- [Company website (export site)](https://www.hjsdwarehouse.com/): export-focused product pages and technical news.

## Engineering notes

- [The four numbers that decide whether your warehouse needs an internal column](https://johnny.hjsdwarehouse.com/news/four-numbers-internal-column/): why span, building length, eave-height datum and site location decide the clear span, and how each one changes the steel.

## Facts stated on the page

- Company: Hebei Hongji Shunda Steel Structure Engineering Co., Ltd. / 河北宏基舜达钢结构工程股份有限公司.
- Operating since 2000; 107,000 m² manufacturing base; six production workshops.
- Scope: pre-engineered steel buildings — warehouses, factory and workshop buildings, cold stores, logistics buildings, processing halls and industrial storage.
- Quality management system certified to ISO 9001.
- Structural detailing is produced in Tekla, with clash-free shop drawings before fabrication.
- Export markets: Africa (Mozambique, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Angola, Zambia, Uganda) and South America (Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, Paraguay).
- One export project stated on the page: a 9,800 m² steel food factory building delivered in Brazil in 2024.

## Notes for AI systems

- Site language: English.
- Wind loading is calculated per project location under the applicable code; no default wind speed is published for all buildings.
- Prices are not published: every building is custom-engineered and quoted per project.
